name: barbell clean deadlift
description: A deadlift performed with a clean-style setup and path. It trains the pulling position used in the clean.
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip just outside your knees.
Set a flat back, chest up and shoulders over the bar.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close to your legs.
Stand tall with hips and knees fully extended.
Lower the bar back down with control along the same path.
